description: This Java class 'Document' defines the data model for storing metadata about uploaded documents such as receipts and invoices. It includes fields for identifiers, metadata, tags, version management, and timestamps, along with constructors and accessor methods. The class is annotated for MongoDB document mapping within a Spring Data framework.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents a logical uploaded document with metadata and references to version history.
